title: LinkPulse
description: URL reality check for agents: status, content hash, classification, wayback fallback.
summary: URL reality check for agents: status, content hash, classification, wayback fallback.
offersHint: URL reality check for agents: status, content hash, classification, wayback fallback. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://linkpulse-neon.vercel.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: linkpulse_check
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a URL and return its current state: HTTP status, final URL after redirects, SHA-256 content hash, classification, readability score, title/meta-description, and wayback archive fallback if dead. Cached 10 minutes.

toolsPreview.name: linkpulse_diff
toolsPreview.description: Re-check a URL and tell you whether its content hash has changed since a previous hash you supply. Returns boolean + new hash.

toolsPreview.name: linkpulse_resolve
toolsPreview.description: Resolve redirect chain for a URL without downloading the full body. Returns final URL + redirect count.

toolsPreview.name: linkpulse_classify
toolsPreview.description: Classify content you already have (status code + content-type + body sample) without an outbound fetch. Useful if your agent already fetched the URL via another tool.
